old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a metallic structure composed of interconnected cubes and spheres, forming a geometric pattern on a plain white surface. The structure is initially static, with its intricate design clearly visible under consistent lighting. A hand enters the frame from the bottom left corner, holding a single cube with a sphere attached to one end. The hand carefully places this component onto the existing structure, integrating it seamlessly into the design. The hand then exits the frame, leaving the modified structure in place. The video captures the precise placement and the resulting change in the geometric pattern, emphasizing the methodical and deliberate nature of the assembly process.

caption: The video showcases an overhead white surface holding a polished silver magnetic-tile lattice with a fixed upper truss panel and four lower legs being reshaped. Bare tile-chain legs hang downward until spheres appear at the outer tips, then at the inner tips, as a hand intermittently touches the bottom edge. The inner legs tilt inward so their new spheres meet at the center, forming a V before straightening again. Horizontal tile chains are laid between the lower spheres, turning the legs into vertical sides of three adjacent squares. A hand adjusts the leftmost horizontal connection, and the left square later buckles outward into a small triangular protrusion. The upper X-braced panel remains in place while the lower framework continues shifting.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
